How Can We Help You? " * " indicates required fields Full Name* * Email Address * Phone* * Message Divorce, despite its challenges, doesn’t always have to be a daunting or overly complicated process. At Lincoln & Wenk, PLLC, we specialize in uncontested divorces in Arizona, offering clear guidance and essential legal support. You’re not navigating this alone; we’re here to achieve a fair resolution while advocating for your rights and the well-being of your family. Schedule a consultation with an uncontested divorce attorney today. Why You Need Legal Advice for an Uncontested Divorce Expertise in Legal Proceedings Even if you and your partner agree on most separation details, there are still many intricacies to family law. We’ll help you fill out all the paperwork and adhere to the proper procedures. Defend Your Rights Even the most civil divorces can become messy and problematic. We’ll work to prevent that from happening while advocating for your rights as an individual and parent. Professional Divorce Negotiations Let’s get this done as quickly and painlessly as possible. We’ll help both parties negotiate how assets and debts will be divided, the terms of custody and visitation, and other crucial matters. Our Uncontested Divorce Attorneys Can Help You With… Uncontested divorces follow the standard divorce process in Arizona, but they’re typically quicker, easier, and less expensive to finalize. In these situations, both parties can reach an agreement with the help of a mediator or attorney. When you hire Lincoln & Wenk, PLLC, we’ll help resolve legal issues regarding: Child Custody & Visitation Protect the best interests of your child. We’ll help you discuss and agree upon custody arrangements and visitation schedules tailored to your family’s needs. Learn More Property Division Our goal is to ensure all assets are divided equitably. This can be a laborious, time-intensive process, but our attorneys streamline it as much as possible. Learn More Child Support Your child’s continuous health and well-being are top priorities. We’ll help you work toward fair financial support arrangements that adequately meet their needs. Learn More Spousal Support (Alimony) If one party makes more than the other, they may be required to provide financial assistance to the other to maintain their standard of living or support their transition to independence. Learn More Divorce Mediation Ultimately, we always strive to facilitate peaceful resolutions in divorces. Our mediation services foster productive, calm discussions to efficiently resolve disputes. Learn More Same-Sex Divorces Same-sex couples need an attorney who understands their legal rights. Our firm offers sensitive, informed counsel tailored to your needs throughout the dissolution process. Learn More Military Divorces Even uncontested military divorces demand expertise in federal and state laws. Our divorce attorneys can handle unique challenges such as deployment schedules and pensions. Learn More Start the Uncontested Divorce Process 0 Divorce is painful and stressful, no matter how amicable it might seem. Although we can’t necessarily make this an enjoyable experience, we can offer transparent, compassionate guidance to streamline your divorce process. Let’s talk. Learn About Your Options The Uncontested Divorce Process in Arizona Meet with an Uncontested Divorce Lawyer Your first step is to schedule a consultation with a lawyer. During your initial meeting, they’ll work to understand the ins and outs of your case, then determine the next step. Preparing & Filing the Divorce Petition We’ll help you dot every i and cross every t on all the necessary legal documents, initiating the divorce process quickly and professionally. Mediation & Negotiation These sessions will be facilitated by your lawyer and focus on resolving any outstanding issues, including disputes on child custody, property division, or financial support. Settlement Agreements We’ll work with you to draft comprehensive divorce settlement agreements detailing the agreed-upon terms. 0.fact: At Lincoln & Wenk, PLLC, we specialize in uncontested divorces in Arizona, offering clear guidance and essential legal support.
0.explanation: Lincoln & Wenk, PLLC is a Phoenix-based law firm specializing in family law, including uncontested divorces in Arizona, providing legal guidance and support as stated on their official website.

1.fact: Uncontested divorces follow the standard divorce process in Arizona, but they’re typically quicker, easier, and less expensive to finalize.
1.explanation: Uncontested divorces in Arizona generally follow the same legal process as contested divorces but are faster, simpler, and less costly because both parties agree on terms, which is consistent with family law practice.

2.fact: When you hire Lincoln & Wenk, PLLC, we’ll help resolve legal issues regarding: Child Custody & Visitation, Property Division, Child Support, Spousal Support (Alimony), Divorce Mediation, Same-Sex Divorces, Military Divorces.
2.explanation: Lincoln & Wenk, PLLC offers comprehensive family law services including child custody, property division, child support, spousal support, mediation, and specialized services for same-sex and military divorces as indicated on their website.

3.fact: If one party makes more than the other, they may be required to provide financial assistance to the other to maintain their standard of living or support their transition to independence.
3.explanation: This describes the concept of spousal support (alimony), which is a standard legal practice in divorce proceedings to ensure financial fairness and support during or after divorce.

4.fact: Even uncontested military divorces demand expertise in federal and state laws. Our divorce attorneys can handle unique challenges such as deployment schedules and pensions.
4.explanation: Military divorces involve additional complexities such as federal laws, deployment issues, and military pensions, requiring specialized legal knowledge, which Lincoln & Wenk, PLLC claims to provide.

5.fact: Your first step is to schedule a consultation with a lawyer. During your initial meeting, they’ll work to understand the ins and outs of your case, then determine the next step.
5.explanation: Scheduling a consultation is the standard initial step in legal proceedings, including uncontested divorces, to assess the case and plan accordingly.

6.fact: We’ll help you dot every i and cross every t on all the necessary legal documents, initiating the divorce process quickly and professionally.
6.explanation: Legal assistance in preparing and filing divorce documents is a typical service provided by family law attorneys to ensure accuracy and compliance.

7.fact: Mediation & Negotiation sessions will be facilitated by your lawyer and focus on resolving any outstanding issues, including disputes on child custody, property division, or financial support.
7.explanation: Mediation and negotiation are common methods used in uncontested divorces to resolve remaining issues amicably with legal guidance.

8.fact: Finally, your lawyer will guide you through the finalization of the divorce decree, ensuring all legal requirements are met and concluding your uncontested divorce.
8.explanation: Finalizing the divorce decree with legal oversight is a standard concluding step in divorce proceedings.
